title: Admission Compass — algorithmic intake scoring & auto-commit choreography for strategic escalations
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Context:
Many top-account escalation requests currently follow an ad-hoc path: AE/Customer Success raises a high-touch ask, PM triages manually, and engineering estimates reactively. That creates long lead times, inconsistent commitments, and missed opportunity to trade scope for time.

What Admission Compass is: an algorithmic intake engine and UI/operational workflow that converts account signals into deterministic admission outcomes and suggested delivery contracts. It should reduce decision latency, make commitments auditable, and surface negotiated partial-deliveries (scoped shaves, feature flags, pilot lenses) with templated contract language.

Core inputs (signals):
- Contract MRR / ARR and renewal date
- Health signals (usage, error rate, SLO breaches)
- Executive advocacy (yes/no + strength tier)
- Security/compliance blockers (regulatory/regression risk)
acceptance_criteria:
1) Intake form in Console captures signal set and computes a stable Admission Score (0-100) with documented weighting.
2) Score maps to one of four deterministic outcomes: Immediate Acceptance (canary + SLA uplift), Scoped Acceptance (deferred full scope, deliver MVP within N sprints), Defer to Backlog, or Executive Escalation (requires cross-functional sign-off).
3) Console shows a suggested negotiated contract template (scope, SLA changes, rollout policy) that PMs can edit and attach to intake.
4) Pilot: for top-10 strategic accounts, 80% of escalations receive Admission Compass recommendation within 48h and 60% acceptance rate vs current baseline.
5) Audit log created for every decision (who accepted, what score, which tradeoffs).
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (Discovery): interview top 20 strategic CSMs/AEs and 6 enterprise PMs to calibrate signals and weighting (2 weeks).
Phase 1 (Alpha): lightweight UI and score engine behind feature flag, pilot with 3 accounts and design templates for partial-deliveries (6 weeks).
Phase 2 (Beta): expand to top-10 accounts, integrate with CRM (SFDC) to create tasks and with Console for visibility (8 weeks).
Phase 3 (GA): enable self-service templates, metrics dashboards, and SLA contract exporter (quarterly release).
metrics_and_success_criteria:
Primary metrics:
- Decision latency: median time from intake creation to decision (target < 48h during pilot).
- Acceptance hit rate for suggested contracts (target > 60% during pilot).
- Forecast accuracy: % of accepted items delivered within negotiated window (target > 75% for pilot cohort).
Secondary metrics:
- Reduction in ad-hoc Slack escalations for top accounts, measured weekly.
- NPS lift from account PMs/CSMs for intake process.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Over-reliance on score leads to poor judgment on edge cases. Mitigation: Always surface rationale and require human approver for >P1-impact decisions.
Risk: Perceived unfairness by mid-market customers. Mitigation: Scope Compass to 'strategic accounts' only in pilot; label decisions and provide appeal channel.
Risk: Legal or procurement pushback on templated partial-delivery contract language. Mitigation: Legal reviews templates before pilot; include clause placeholders for customer negotiations.
